subject: general
question: Find the simple interest on ₹800 at 7% per month in 9 months.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹800

Rate of Interest (R) = 7% per month

Time (T) = 9 months

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100

**Calculation:**

SI = (800 × 7 × 9) / 100

⇒ SI = (800 × 63) / 100

⇒ SI = 50400 / 100

⇒ SI = 504

**The simple interest on ₹800 at 7% per month in 9 months is ₹504.**
